subjects.name: The Way of the Shadow Wolves

summary: A reading of The Way of the Shadow Wolves, a self-published 2018 novel by actor Steven Seagal and ex-US Marshal Tom Morrissey that casts a Seagal stand-in as a Native tracker fighting a Deep State, cartels and jihadists in Arizona.
keywords: The Deep State and the Hijacking of America

evidence.note: co-author Tom Morrissey introduced, former US Marshal and Payson AZ mayoral candidate
publisher's last post, January 2018, announces the book's publication
foreword by Sheriff Joe Arpaio read and critiqued at length
preface pushes Vatican and banking-family Deep State conspiracy
Islamophobic pig-blood knife fight passage and Sharia plot discussed
novel frames border, cartels and media as an open-borders Deep State plot
novel set in the Arizona desert south of Phoenix
hosts discuss Seagal's claimed Native ancestry and appropriation
Seagal's honorary deputization by Arpaio explained

notes: Primary given to both the book and Seagal since the title names him. Covered span uses the book's publication year; the opening rundown of Seagal's earlier allegations is a brief list, not a narrated period. Arpaio's own crimes are mentioned only briefly. No theme for cultural appropriation; folded into racism. hate-speech warning considered for the read Islamophobic passages but left out as not extended.
